description: Checkpoint-oriented block scales are not transposed alongside their weights.
trigger: An eagerly loaded checkpoint supplies a scale grid aligned with its original [out_features,in_features] weight rather than the internal transposed matrix.
expected_behavior: Preserve each weight block's associated scale through transposition.
actual_behavior: A rectangular grid can fail the shape assertion; a square asymmetric grid passes but assigns off-diagonal block scales to the wrong blocks.

verification.description: Modeled the exact 128-block shape condition and compared transposed versus untransposed scale indexing. The helper is new; parent search found no existing callers, and the task adds only the load_fp16 call.
verification.limits: Conditional compatibility observation: no inspected checkpoint establishes that it uses this orientation.
